profile.visual_desc: Slender elf with floor-length blue hair tied in a low ponytail. Wears brown and olive-green robes with dark boots. Rear-isometric view.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Elegant female face with large brown eyes and blue eyebrows. Wears a gold filigree headband with a red gem. Calm expression.
profile.weapon_desc: Wooden magic staff topped with a purple crystal orb, held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Standing rear-view facing ↖. Staff held diagonally across the back; hair flows down to the heels.
profile.step2_windup: Rotates torso right and raises the staff high over the head, preparing a casting motion.
profile.step3_impact: Lunges forward toward ↖. The staff is thrust downward, releasing a purple magical energy burst from the crystal orb.
profile.step4_finish: Holds the forward lunging stance as the magic energy dissipates, then gradually pulls back to a neutral position.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The magical energy flare in Frame 4 aligns perfectly with the downward thrusting trajectory of the staff's crystal tip.
